purpose: Separate market selection, product definition, representative experience, product quality, technical manufacturability and external preview evidence.

waivers.REPRESENTATIVE_PRODUCT: Allowed only when the product profile does not materially depend on unusual design, pedagogy, comparison, workbook usability or information architecture.
waivers.LANGUAGE_QA: Allowed for a single-language book after explicit declaration.

invariants: PRODUCT_QUALITY is independent from FACTUAL_SOURCE, EDITORIAL and TECHNICAL
TECHNICAL PASS cannot change PRODUCT_QUALITY FAIL
KDP READY requires every mandatory gate
PAGE COUNT is neither cost nor value
human taste is retained where marginal value is high
